name: typing
title: Typing
description: A typing test in the manner of monkeytype: common English words, a smooth caret, a timed, a counted or a free (zen) test, a pace caret and stop on error, and a result with wpm, accuracy, raw speed, consistency and a chart of the test second by second. Personal bests per test kind and the history persist, with a stats page: progress chart, bests, every past test.
author: pal

store.tagline: Monkeytype-style typing test: wpm, accuracy, a chart, personal bests
features: Common English words in three lines that scroll as you go, a caret that glides from letter to letter, the letters coloured as you type them: right, wrong, extra, and a word left wrong underlined

Time (15, 30, 60, 120 seconds), words (10, 25, 50, 100) or zen (type anything, Enter ends it), punctuation and numbers on top; picked on the bar above the words, with the arrows before you start, or from ⌘K
The clock starts on the first key; the bar and the hints fade while you type
A pace caret to race your best, your average or your last test; stop on error by letter or by word; both settings, also switched from ⌘K
The result: wpm and accuracy large, raw speed, consistency, the letters right, wrong, extra and missed, and a chart of the wpm, the raw speed and the mistakes second by second
Personal bests for every kind of test, a new one marked; the average of your last ten of that kind beside it

Stats and history: tests, time typing, highest and average wpm, accuracy and consistency, all tests or one kind; a progress chart with the average of ten; the bests for every length; every past test in a table
Tab starts a new test at any point, R on the result repeats the same words

actions.title: New test
actions.description: New words, the same options; mid-test the test is dropped.

actions.title: Repeat the test
actions.description: The same words again, from the result.

actions.title: Stats and history
actions.description: The stats button on the bar, S on the result, or cmd+k.

actions.title: Change the test
actions.description: Before the first key: up and down switch time and words, left and right the length.

settings.label: Pace caret
settings.description: A second, fainter caret that moves at a steady speed for you to race: your personal best, the average of your last ten or your last test of the same kind (time 30, words 50 with punctuation, and so on). Nothing to race until you have finished one of that kind; never in zen. Also switched from ⌘K.

settings.label: Stop on error
settings.description: Letter: a wrong letter is not typed, the caret waits for the right one. Word: a word with a mistake cannot be left with space until it is fixed. Either way the wrong key counts against accuracy. Also switched from ⌘K.

settings.label: Clock
settings.text: Show the seconds while you type
settings.description: The seconds left in a time test, or so far in zen. Off hides them: a time test still ends on time and the result shows how long it took. The word count of a words test stays. Also ⌘T or ⌘K.

typing.description: The test. Type the words (in zen, anything; Enter ends it); Tab starts a new one; Escape leaves (a test in progress is dropped).

keys.title: The next word; the letters left in this one are missed
Take back a letter; at the start of a word, back into the one before if it was left wrong
Before the first key: a shorter test (right, a longer one)
Before the first key: time, words or zen (down too)
On the result: the same words again
On the result: a new test
On the result: stats and history (tab, enter or s again closes them)
